audit.outcome_boundary: Repository landing pages, identifiers, access conditions, file names, resource types, methods, and public publication or metadata summaries were inspected. No newly located participant file was downloaded, opened, parsed, or evaluated; no candidate participant-level outcome was inspected. Public metadata sometimes displayed aggregate results, which were treated only as exposure to document and never as a basis for changing the frozen PCQ-1.3 limits.

author and cohort names combined with data, dataset, raw data, supplement, and repository
healthy human invasive exercise hemodynamics with mPAP, PAWP, and cardiac output
healthy human five-lobe or regional pulmonary perfusion
functional pulmonary capillary blood volume, pulmonary blood volume, and pulmonary transit
healthy exercise, posture, cardiac output, lung water, and multimodal hemodynamic alternatives
permitted_inspection: repository landing-page metadata and access controls
resource type, persistent identifier, licence field, file names, sizes, and checksums
publication abstract, methods, data-availability statement, and public aggregate summary
supplement type and non-numeric document structure needed to decide whether participant data exist
forbidden_inspection: download or opening of a newly located participant-level dataset
parsing or summarizing participant-level outcome values
running a PCQ comparison before rights and activation checks pass
changing frozen candidate roles, observation models, or numeric limits in response to outcomes

alternative_sources.title: Posture matters: how body position shapes cardiopulmonary response to maximal exercise testing
alternative_sources.license: No licence was displayed in the repository metadata at the audit cutoff; reuse must remain blocked pending clarification.
alternative_sources.population: Twelve healthy adults, mean age approximately 31 years, half female.
alternative_sources.reason: It is unusually close in age, posture, state, and stage-level cardiac output, but lacks invasive mPAP and PAWP and therefore cannot satisfy the primary PCQ-H tuple or replace Arizona.

alternative_sources.title: HeartCycle: A comprehensive dataset of synchronized impedance cardiography and echocardiography for accurate hemodynamic predictions
alternative_sources.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
alternative_sources.population: Seventeen healthy volunteers represented by 208 multimodal records.
states: multiple physiological study runs described by activity labels
alternative_sources.reason: It can test cardiac-output observation methods and healthy variability but contains no invasive pulmonary arterial or wedge pressure tuple and is not a replacement PCQ-H cohort.

alternative_sources.title: SCG-RHC: Wearable Seismocardiogram Signal and Right Heart Catheter Database
alternative_sources.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
alternative_sources.population: Seventy-three patients referred for heart-failure hemodynamic evaluation, ages 26 to 84 years.
alternative_sources.reason: The invasive tuple is valuable, but the heart-failure referral population and pharmacological rather than exercise perturbation are outside the frozen healthy recumbent claim.

alternative_sources.title: Method to Assess Lung Water Accumulation During Exercise
alternative_sources.license: Authorized access under a Data Use Certification; redistribution is not assumed.
alternative_sources.population: Twelve healthy volunteers plus two stable-heart-failure participants in the reported human feasibility cohort.
measurements: dynamic quantitative MRI of extravascular lung water
alternative_sources.reason: The repository-backed healthy exercise data may support a future lung-water or gas-exchange extension, but extravascular lung water is not a frozen PCQ-H, PCQ-R, PCQ-C, or PCQ-J endpoint.

alternative_sources.title: Pulmonary Vascular Disease Phenomics Program (PVDOMICS)
alternative_sources.license: Authorized access under repository and consent terms; redistribution is restricted.
alternative_sources.population: Pulmonary vascular disease groups, disease comparators, and healthy controls in a multicenter deep-phenotyping program.
states: invasive CPET for selected pulmonary-hypertension participants
alternative_sources.reason: Official controlled access exists, but the published protocol does not establish healthy invasive exercise mPAP-PAWP-cardiac-output trajectories and the multicenter cohort requires an overlap audit.

decision.conclusion: Repositories materially improve supplementary method, posture, cardiac-output, disease-stress, and future lung-water evidence, but none of the located objects replaces the rights-authorized participant-level data needed by the frozen PCQ-1.3 primary endpoints. Repository access and physiological eligibility are separate dimensions.

contact_queue.purpose: Joint stage-matched functional pulmonary capillary volume, cardiac output, hematological covariates, covariance, and reuse terms.
Healthy supine invasive multipoint mPAP, PAWP, and cardiac-output trajectories plus uncertainty and reuse terms.
Participant-level five-lobe perfusion fractions, posture and acquisition metadata, uncertainty, and reuse terms.
Participant-level pulmonary transit feasibility only after an independently reviewed whole-pulmonary observation model is available.

decision.activation_rule: Do not download or inspect any alternative participant file for qualification. First create and independently review a successor pre-outcome amendment that names its source role, endpoint, population, posture, observation model, licence, covariance treatment, overlap decision, and numeric rule; then pass PCQ-1.4 rights-aware ingress. Existing frozen primary roles and limits remain unchanged.
